cefrAlignment: Fits B2: two IELTS-style passages of 384 and 412 words, TOEFL everyday and academic texts (59–174 words) and a TOEIC double passage, covering the course's question types at an appropriate density for the level.
examFidelity: Task formats match exams.ts (IELTS headings/TFNG/summary/features/MCQ/notes; TOEFL Daily Life texts with 2–3 questions and an academic text with 5 questions; TOEIC double passage with 5 questions). 46 items in 40 minutes is realistic. I solved all 46 before reading the key, and each has one defensible answer.
fixes: Consistency only: Section 4 Text 1 has To/From/Subject headers, so it is now called a memo rather than a notice (title, instructions, one option and two explanations)
openConcerns: The score bands (40–46 = ready for C1, etc.) are reasonable internal guidance but not calibrated against learner data; a specialist could pilot them.
learnerOutcome: A learner can work through mixed exam-format reading under time pressure and use the score bands to choose which B2 lessons to review.
